description: The pie chart visually represents the distribution of ten distinct relational association categories evaluated in the MMRA benchmark for large visual language models, with each slice corresponding to a specific relation type and its associated count and percentage of the total. The largest segment is “ObservationAngle” at 126 instances (12.28%), followed by “SimilarMaterial” at 106 (10.33%), “SubEvent” at 100 (9.74%), and “UsageSimilarity” also at 100 (9.65%). Four categories — “SimilarEvent,” “AppearanceSimilarity,” “Layout,” and “NearSameEntity” — each account for 90 instances (8.77% each), while “MentalitySimilarity” has 89 (8.67%) and “RelativePosition” has 81 (7.90%). The smallest segment is “NearSameEntity” at 63 (6.34%). Each slice is color-coded and labeled with its category name, count, and percentage, arranged in descending order clockwise from the top-left, with no exploded or emphasized segments, and no separate legend required as all labels are directly on the chart.
